notes: Cosan S.A. (B3: CSAN3, NYSE: CSAN) — diversified Brazilian conglomerate. Holdings: 44% of Raízen (sugar/ethanol/fuel distribution JV with Shell, B3: RAIZ4); ~99% of Rumo (logistics/rail, RAIL3); Compass (gas distribution, B3: CGAS3); Moove (lubricants, NYSE: MOOV); ~5% of Vale (acquired 2022). Acres figure (~2.1M acres / ~850k ha) reflects Raízen-managed sugarcane area (proportionate). Heavy holdco leverage on Vale stake — pressured FY24 net income.

periods.notes: FY20 (pre-2021 reorg / Compass spinoff included): Revenue R$21.1bn, EBITDA R$5.86bn.
FY21: Revenue R$24.4bn, EBITDA R$7.4bn — Raízen IPO Aug 2021 raised R$6.9bn; reorganization year.
FY22: Revenue R$33.1bn (+36%), EBITDA R$11.8bn — Vale stake acquired (~R$23bn collar funded), drove leverage up.
FY23: Revenue R$39.2bn (+19%), EBITDA R$13.1bn (margin 33.3%). Vale dividends supported NI. Net debt reduced via Compass divestments + Moove dividend recap.

FY24: Revenue R$41.7bn (+6%), EBITDA R$12.8bn (margin 30.8%). Net loss ~R$4.5bn driven by mark-to-market on Vale collar + monetization losses (~R$7bn impact). Moove IPO pulled in 2024. Leverage at holdco elevated; deleveraging plan announced.
